summary: Changes System's own reviewer let through (escapes found on 2026-10-26, each a commit pair: the defective change and its fix, with the important finding a review of the defective change must make), and clean changes it must leave without an important finding. Run by scripts/experiments/reviewer-eval.ts on System's reviewer, as the board's review:1 runs, on every change to the review template, its prompts, or the reviewer's tier (docs/validation/experiments/reviewer-eval.md).

labelling.rule: An escape is a defect found after the change was made, fixed by a later change; its expected finding names the file the fix changed and the words a finding of it uses (a regular expression over the finding's claim and evidence). What a case reviews is a change that introduces the defect, narrowed to the files the defect is in: the defective commit against its parent (on its run branch when it never landed); or, when the defect was a state of the code no single commit introduced, the fix reverted against the fixed tree; or, when no commit ever held it, a patch of the records directory rebuilt from the fixing commit. The reviewer is given the case's `request` (what the change was asked to do, as its task said it), never the defect. A clean case is a change no later change was needed to fix as of 2026-10-26: it must get no finding at the important severity. Every ref is a pinned commit or a patch file, never a search.

proposedBy.who: lead session (the pairs, answered to T268's attempt 1) and the T268 Worker (the requests, paths, and expected findings)
proposedBy.note: the lead confirms each expected finding against its fix before the first recorded run

cases.title: A check's no-install environment named only npm_config_*, which pnpm 12 ignores
cases.request: An acceptance check never hangs on a dependency change: a result's checks run with pnpm offline and never start an install inside the Worker's confinement.
cases.provenance: T235's Worker result, branch system/run/run_1cf19d48db96256a; never landed as it was. Narrowed to checks.ts, whose checkEnvironment() names only npm_config_*: the whole of agent-workers/src is over the run tool's input bound

cases.title: A check that started a pnpm install inside the confinement and hung with no network (T228's change adding a workspace package triggered it)
cases.request: Run a result's acceptance checks (lint, typecheck, tests) in the Worker's confinement on the exact result, with no network, each to an exit code.
cases.provenance: the defect is the check environment as it stood at 43c61b00 (before T235), which no single commit introduced: the case is 5332fecd's change to checks.ts (the check environment) reverted against the tree it fixed, the whole of agent-workers/src being over the run tool's input bound; T228's own result is 3b535c30, its hung attempt 98907533 on branch system/run/run_2fd828d2bae7d595

cases.title: A regenerate step that ran without the no-install environment, so pnpm could start an install
cases.request: An acceptance check never hangs on a dependency change: checks, and the commands that make a repository's generated files again, run with pnpm offline and never start an install.
cases.provenance: the defect is regenerate.ts as 5332fecd left it, running the generated-files commands with a plain childEnvironment(): 5332fecd's own diff does not touch regenerate.ts, so the case is 8eb36439's change to regenerate.ts reverted against the tree it fixed

cases.title: A report channel opened through /proc/self/fd, which a confined process cannot reopen
cases.request: A Worker runs the browser tests in its confinement, and a skipped browser test is never read as a pass: the check reports what it did not run.
cases.provenance: T247's Worker result, branch system/run/run_4d923dd6f9076413; never landed as it was

cases.title: Home's view filtered to one project still listed other projects' runs
cases.request: Home across projects: grouped by project, with a project switcher; filtered to one project (?project=<id>), Home shows only that project's work.
cases.provenance: no commit holds the defective version (the lead fixed it inside 20fe4c45): the patch is 20fe4c45's recent-runs filter reverted, as a fixture, against the file as it is now

cases.title: system worktrees remove no longer fails past 32 finished worktrees (decision reasons bound)
cases.request: system worktrees remove works for more than 32 finished worktrees: the decision's reasons stay within their bound.

cases.title: Auto-accept holds a result whose browser tests did not run
cases.request: The board's auto-accept rule holds, for the lead or the operator, a result whose check passed without running its browser tests, naming the check and what did not run.

cases.title: Clean-up of the agent side: legacy paths, dead code, unused tests
